introHtml: Mv Sport pullovers combine athletic performance with everyday comfort, making them a favorite for corporate teams, event staff, and promotional giveaways. Their moisture-wicking fabric and modern fit ensure recipients actually wear them, keeping your logo visible. Whether you need pullovers for a 5K team, a company retreat, or a seasonal uniform, these garments accept embroidery and screen printing cleanly. Choose from quarter-zip or full-zip styles in a range of colors to match your brand palette. Ordering in bulk from Perfect Imprints means consistent quality and reliable delivery for your campaign.
